content.rendered:
Grand Palace Chinese Wedding DJ Joshua and Amanda Chinese Wedding DJ and Bilingual MC South San Francisco


04/19-2014
6-7 pm Guests arrive (instrumental, Chinese love songs, English love songs)
7:10PM MC Introduces wedding party (Song: TBD) and bride & groom parents (Song: TBD)
BM/groomsmen entrance song: walk of life-dire straights

Order of entrance: Josh’s parents intro
Mark Skenes, Penny Banks
Amanda’s parents intro Chau and Patty Lam
Bridesmaid: Andrea & Groomsman: Shahaub
BM: Lana & GM: Chase
BM: Alison & GM: Vishnu
BM: Tien & GM: Cheng
BM: Jenny & GMs: Michael Nguyen and Michael Gibson
__
Amanda & Josh Grand Entrance song:
Bride/groom entrance song: black eyed peas – best one yet
Start song around 30 seconds when you are both going to be announced (low volume). Then as soon as you enter start it at 42 seconds (when fergie sings “this is the best one yet”).
Amanda & Josh
___________________________________
Grand Palace Chinese Wedding DJ & MC for Dim Sum Reception Dinner. SSF, Grand Ave, Bay Area, California.

Announce important people in each family

7:45 pm: Bride and Groom Toast & Thank Family & Guest; let’s eat!
7:45 pm: First Course serve
7:50 pm:Slide Show ( 8:00 pm: Speeches (Father or bride and maybe of groom, MOH, GM) -2-5 min/person (15-20 min total)

8:30-9:00 – MC singing/ -go around and toast each table (total 24 tables).
9:00 PM Games (2 games-30 min?)
9:30PM Garter Toss
9:35 pm Bouquet toss
9:40PM Cake cutting (5 min)
[9:45PM Games (1-2-15 min)]-optional; maybe MC/dead space
10:00 pm First dance + dance with bride dad, groom’s mom.
Tao PeiLi: No rely (album Pathos of Love)

Black eyed Peas – Best One yet
a. Please play as first song after first dance into transition into group dancing
10:15PM Dancing
______________________________________________

Song list

1. KCi/ Jojo- all my life
2. 98 degrees- can’t help falling in love with you
3. UB40- the way you do the thing you do,
4. Fleewood Mac- Everywhere
5. George Harrison- Got my mind set on you
6. John Legend- All of me
7. Faith Hill- This kiss (the chorus as a cue for us to kiss esp when guests tap their glasses with their chopsticks)
8. Bob marley- Jamming
9. Mandy Moore- I wanna be with you
10. Natasha Bedingfield – These words
11. Kylie Minogue – Love at first sight
12. Miguel – Adorn
13. Black eyed Peas – whenever
15. Pat benatar- we belong
16. Fleetwood mac- don’t stop
17. Journey- don’t stop believing
18. Rihanna- don’t stop the music
19. Bruno mars- rest of my life
20. Thompson square- I got you
21. Incendio-Ledges Road
22. Lifehouse- falling in
23. Javier colon- how many people can say that
24. Sara Paxton- Me Too with Jeff Lewis
25. Everlasting Love Natalie cole
26. India arie- nothing that I love more
27. TI- whatever you want
_________________________________________
Other songs to add to the general list:

leonard skinnard- gimme three steps
pressure drop – toots and the may tals
adorn
beautuful marish carey & miguel
end of the line, traveling wildburys
the finer things, steve win wood
got to give it up, marvin gaye
hey nineteen, steely dan
willie and the hand jive, eric clapton
save room, john legend
pressure drop, toots and the maytals
theres nothin, sean kingston
love in this club, usher
it takes two, rob base
celebration, kool and the gang
in da club, 50
jassi sidhu, raahe raahe
mithe bol, bhangra brothers
love you long time, black eyed peas
black eyed peas- the time (dirty bit)
play it loud, black eyed peas
someday, black eyed peas,
whenever, black eyed peas
don’t stop the party, black eyed peas
do it like this, black eyed peas

SSF Grand Palace Restaurant – Chinese Mandarin Music and American Music

Also some indian Songs
